mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn can cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which can lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a potential mismatch in monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are declining, it signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening demand, which can lead to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is increasing and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is decreasing, it signals a supportive environment for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
